newVault(address,address,address,bytes).details: IMPORTANT: The taxToken does not exist yet when this method is called.      The VaultPortal predicts the token address and passes it here.      The actual token will be created AFTER the vault is created.

params.creator: The original msg.sender to VaultPortal who initiated token creation
params.quoteToken: The quote token address (e.g., address(0) for native BNB)
params.taxToken: The predicted address of the tax token (not yet deployed)
params.vaultData: Custom encoded data specific to this vault type

returns.vault: The address of the newly created vault

isQuoteTokenSupported(address).notice: Checks if a quote token is supported by this vault factory
